name: archetype
description: Synthetic Archetype for Claude Code: test your product as if your customers were sitting beside you. Persona runs and behavioral studies in isolated browsers, with faithful, structured feedback.

plugins.name: archetype
plugins.description: Test your product with synthetic personas. Run one persona through a flow in a real browser, or run a behavioral study: the plugin picks the behavioral factors that matter for your users (patience, trust, familiarity and more), generates an archetype per factor plus a baseline and a stress case, runs them in parallel isolated headless browsers with a video per run, and reports completion per archetype, which factor made people give up, with what confidence, and what to change.
